subject: PrivateLab: Subsidy for Isolated Trial + Evidence Coordination
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@privatelab.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@privatelab.com
Date: 2026-11-18T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Trial request: isolated environment + subsidy

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at PrivateLab is excited about Redwood’s runtime for inference in an isolated VPC. We have a short internal compliance window to run an isolated, audited POC (data residency + no egress) and we need two things from Redwood to proceed: 1) a short checklist of the evidence you can provide (SOC2, network diagrams, KMS flow), and 2) some sandbox credits that will allow our security and ML infra teams to run ~100k tokens/day for 4 weeks in a private instance.

Is there a standard path for a subsidized trial when the gating criterion is security evidence? We can share our SRA and a short questionnaire — attaching a placeholder SRA we typically use.

Appreciate any guidance and a ballpark on how long approvals take.

—Elena
Elena Soto
Head of ML Platforms | PrivateLab Inc.
Attachment: privatelab_sra_v1.pdf

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@privatelab.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-18T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trial request: isolated environment + subsidy

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear ask and for the SRA.

Short answer: yes — we have a "security-gated sandbox" flow for isolated Private/VPC POCs. We can provide a compliance evidence bundle (SOC 2 summary, network topology sketch, and KMS integration notes) plus a temporary credit allocation tied to acceptance of the proof-of-concept MOU. Typical timing for a straightforward case is 3–7 business days for review and credit issuance; if your security team needs deeper artifacts we may need 1–2 extra weeks.

Next steps I propose:
- Rishi (cc) will scope the expected token compute and confirm the target instance sizing for an isolated node.
- Grace (cc) will confirm the evidence bundle we can share immediately and what requires an NDA or redaction.
- Elena, if you can send the completed questionnaire (even partial) we can fast-track.

I'll attach our POC guidelines to this thread so your infra team can see what the sandbox looks like.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_poc_guidelines.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Elena Soto <elena.soto@privatelab.com>
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-19T15:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trial request: isolated environment + subsidy

Hi all — quick technical notes from our side:

- For an isolated VPC trial with KMS integration and no egress, the usual sizing for ~100k tokens/day (mixed gen + embed) is a single T4-multi GPU-backed service with autoscale off (dedicated sandbox). We can cap concurrency to keep costs predictable.
- On the credits: Sales Ops typically issues a "sandbox voucher" that covers compute for a fixed window. For a 4-week run at your stated throughput I estimate ~USD 5.5k in equivalent hosted usage. If you need 6 weeks we can propose USD 8k.
- Evidence we can share immediately (no NDA): SOC2 summary (control map), network diagram (sanitized), KMS integration notes. We will need either a mutual NDA or a data-processing addendum for deeper artifacts (e.g., key custody screenshots).

Elena — if you can confirm acceptance of a 4-week vs 6-week window today, I’ll open the voucher request and flag security for the minimal artifacts we can drop into your secure channel.

Technical contact: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@privatelab.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: security@privatelab.com
Date: 2026-11-20T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trial request: isolated environment + subsidy

Hi Naomi / Rishi — thanks, this is helpful.

We completed the short questionnaire and attached the file here. Given our calendar we’d prefer a 6-week window so the ML team can complete a stability run + two model checkpoints. We’re happy to sign a standard mutual NDA if that’s needed for deeper artifacts.

One ask: because this POC needs to run inside our guarded environment (no egress) the security team wants the sandbox voucher to be issued to an account tied to our private VPC team rather than a broad org-level token. Can Redwood accommodate that?

I’m attaching our completed questionnaire. Let me know if anything else is required.

Thanks,
—Elena
Attachment: privatelab_questionnaire_completed.pdf
